reports.description: Case SummaryMagido likely seeking opportunities in the cryptocurrency market, was targeted by an online scammer posing as "Liza" on Datig App and directed to WhatsApp. Through a series of manipulative tactics, "Liza" gained Magido's trust and led him to deposit Bitcoin into a fraudulent trading platform called metatrade365.com. After a short period of simulated trading activity, Magido attempted to withdraw his funds but was met with failure, revealing the fraudulent nature of the platform.Timeline of EventsInitial Contact and Trust Building (Image: WhatsApp Conversation)"Liza " initiates contact with Magido on WhatsApp, engaging in friendly conversation and building rapport."Liza " presents herself as an experienced trader with a connection to a "professional" trader (her "uncle")."Liza " introduces metatrade365.com as a legitimate and profitable trading platform.Trust Wallet Setup and Initial Deposit (Images: Trust Wallet Home Page, Trust Wallet Discover Page)"Liza " instructs Magido to download Trust Wallet, a legitimate cryptocurrency wallet, and guides him through the process."Liza " asks Magido to share a screenshot of his Trust Wallet home page to verify the setup."Liza " directs Magido to the "Discover" tab within Trust Wallet, likely to access metatrade365.com through a disguised link.Account Creation and Funding (Images: metatrade365.com Website, metatrade365.com Dashboard, metatrade365.com Deposit Page)Magido is led to the metatrade365.com website, which appears professional and legitimate."Liza " instructs Magido to create an account on the platform.Magido is then guided to deposit Bitcoin from his Trust Wallet into his metatrade365.com account."Liza " likely uses screenshots and step-by-step instructions to ensure Magido follows her directions precisely.Simulated Trading Activity (Images: metatrade365.com Trading Interface, metatrade365.com Trade Log)Once the fake balance is updated on Magido's metatrade365.com dashboard, "Liza " instructs him to start trading."Liza " provides specific trade instructions ("signals") and amounts, creating a false sense of profitable trading.Magido is shown a "Trade Log" with fabricated successful trades, further reinforcing the illusion of legitimacy.Withdrawal Failure and Realization (Image: Failed Transaction Notification)When Magido attempts to withdraw his funds from metatrade365.com, he encounters a failed transaction notification.This reveals the fraudulent nature of the platform and confirms that Magido has been scammed.Post-Scam Actions (Images: Cryptocurrency Exchange App - Withdraw Button, Withdrawal Screen, Withdrawal Confirmation)Magido, realizing the scam, attempts to withdraw his remaining funds from his separate cryptocurrency exchange account
